d: Peggy's hoard of filth and dead animal carcasses has led the city to deem her house uninhabitable.  If she does not clean up, city officials will not allow Peggy to return.
Linda's family has been ripped apart by hoarding.
Charles' house is filled with thousands of the nude paintings he has done.
Terry's fridge is packed with dead cats, and she has another 50 live ones. Her son thinks her problems stem from the time her father died of a heart attack right in front of her.

Former famed interior designer, Sandra, has hoarded out every square inch of the historic mansion she lost to foreclosure. She refuses to leave the manor in spite of the fact the bank has sold it to a new couple.
Shanna owns the worst hoard in “Hoarders” history — a house crammed floor to ceiling with bottles filled with human waste.
Ruby, aka Big Momma's house, is so hoarded she spends her entire day living in the car, and her grandson has started running the streets of LA.
After the death of her newborn son, Chris filled the void by surrounding herself with possessions.
Roxann is a former model who has successfully hidden her hoarding until now. Barbara's extreme hoarding has forced her out of her house.
Ronald is a firefighter who is legally mandated to report hoarded homes. But in this case, the hoarder is his wife, Eileen, and the house is his own.
Vula is hoarding more than 30 sickly cats that have completely destroyed her home.
Lonnie is a famed neurosurgeon and former Lt. Governor of the State of Nevada.
Becky's hoard fills 16 separate storage units and the monthly fees have driven her into debt. Currently living with her son and his fiancee, she has also started to hoard in their house.
BG and Lee have filled their million-dollar Victorian home with hoards of stuff--and now are even competing to see who can bring in the most stuff.
Manuel was living in his hoarded house with his four grandchildren.
Doug, who suffered severe brain trauma and memory loss in an accident, hoards items he feels might trigger his memories.
